arms.form: Native worker roles and V2 tool registration; qualify actual mode, fork and task identity
Org-maintained experimental codex_tool with a constructed native Codex instance; supported as_tool orchestration and native cleanup

native_lifecycle_controls.class: unchanged upstream fixtures; commands not executed
native_lifecycle_controls.method: justfile:test uses cargo-nextest. Freeze bounded supported just test invocations; fixture pass is separate from useful-task and live route acceptance.

controls.oracle: Canonical task path and native relative addressing
Separate completed-turn notifications; retain their native linkage
Target receives Op::Interrupt; neither target nor child receives Op::Shutdown; child does not receive Op::Interrupt. Interruption is not tree shutdown.
Native lazy resume preserves identity/role; mock/high fixture is not live Sol/Ultra acceptance
Internal controller fixture establishes descendant shutdown; it is not an externally registered V2 shutdown API
A subsequent native resume succeeds with the same thread identity

native_lifecycle_controls.registration_limits: V2 has spawn/send/followup/optionalwait/interrupt/list. Legacy resume/close registration and internal shutdown helper do not imply an external V2 close endpoint.

useful_task_option.name: CooperBench through the maintained Harbor adapter
useful_task_option.oracle: Pinned native verifier only; both features must pass. Existing method permits union-merge fallback and can exit0 with reward0. Do not infer success from exit alone.
useful_task_option.limits: Ordinary single Codex agent selection is not the official two-sidecar/communication setup. Adapter loads an unversioned dataset and a main-branch patch source; freeze both. A common native integration for these three arms remains unestablished in reviewed sources.

sdk_binding_gaps: Agents codex_tool default key resolution can inject ambient provider keys; use a supported constructed Codex instance and bind an environment excluding ambient credential inputs without inspecting their values
Agents Codex exec adapter forwards experimental-json and native effort string, but public effort Literal omits max/ultra; qualification must observe requested and delivered mappings separately
Local workspace is not the benchmark sidecar isolation or communication boundary
Agents tool usage requests=1 per completed turn and reasoning0 are adapter conventions; retain native raw missingness and count cumulative/child totals once
Actual lifecycle, role-extension activation and matching native benchmark environment/task assignment for each runtime

design.order: Rotate paired arm order on identical useful tasks

selection_rule.requirements: Common useful-task oracle, actual route/role parity and separate spawn/resume/cancel/shutdown controls
selection_rule.quality: Paired no-regression on every task/repeat; improved native reward or successful useful artifacts
selection_rule.tie: Predeclared five-percent paired uncached-input-plus-output reduction with complete comparable scopes and no greater median elapsed time; unknown totals do not establish a saving
selection_rule.limits: Lifecycle fixture success and broader API surfaces cannot select a default

freeze_gaps: Frozen dataset/patch/images/task IDs and worker-visible inputs
Claude exact-head read and exclusive pool allocation
